units.source_text: 数年之后，这皇妃又生了一位皇子。

en.t: Several years later, this consort gave birth to another imperial prince.

units.source_text: 冷泉院后宫诸后妃，多年以来从未生过男儿，

en.t: For many years, none of the consorts in Reizei-in's inner palace had ever borne a son,

units.source_text: 现在这皇妃居然生了皇子，世人都认为是特殊的宿缘，大家不胜惊喜。

en.t: so now that this consort had unexpectedly given birth to a prince, people thought it must be a special bond from a previous life, and everyone was filled with astonished joy.

units.source_text: 冷泉院更是喜出望外，非常疼爱这位小皇子。

en.t: Reizei-in himself was even more delighted than he had hoped to be, and he cherished the little prince deeply.

units.source_text: 但念若在未退位时，此事何等风光。

en.t: Yet he thought how splendid this would have been if it had happened before he abdicated.

units.source_text: 可惜到了现在，万事都减色了。

en.t: Regrettably, now that things had come to this point, everything had lost some of its luster.

units.source_text: 本来只有弘徽殿女御所生大公主一人，冷泉院对她疼爱无以复加。

en.t: Before this, there had been only the eldest princess born to the Kokiden lady, and Reizei-in had loved her beyond measure.

units.source_text: 现在这新皇妃连生这样俊美的皇女和皇子，冷泉院对她异常重视，特别宠幸。

en.t: Now this new consort had borne such beautiful imperial children, both a princess and a prince, one after the other, and Reizei-in valued her extraordinarily and favored her above others.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿女御便认为偏爱过分，动了嫉妒之心。

en.t: The Kokiden lady therefore felt that his favoritism had gone too far, and jealousy stirred in her heart.

units.source_text: 于是每遇事故，往往发生龃龉，不得安静。

en.t: After that, whenever anything happened, disagreements often arose, and there was no peace.

units.source_text: 女御与皇妃之间自然有了隔阂。

en.t: A rift naturally formed between the lady and the imperial consort.

units.source_text: 就世间一般人情看来，

en.t: Judging by ordinary human feeling in the world,

units.source_text: 无论身份低微的人家，对于首先进来而地位正当的人，

en.t: even in a household of humble rank, a person who entered first and holds a proper position

units.source_text: 即使是无甚关系的人，亦必特别重视。

en.t: is always treated with special regard, even if she has no very close connection.

units.source_text: 因此冷泉院内上下人等，连些些小事也都袒护出身高贵、入侍年久的弘徽殿女御而指斥新皇妃为非。

en.t: For that reason, everyone high and low in Reizei-in's household sided even in small matters with the Kokiden lady, who was nobly born and had served for many years, and blamed the new consort instead.

units.source_text: 于是新皇妃的两兄更加振振有词了，对母亲说道：“请看如何！

en.t: The new consort's two elder brothers then became still more confident in their arguments and said to their mother, "Now look at this!

units.source_text: 我们的话没有说错吧。”

en.t: We were not wrong in what we said, were we?"

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人听了很不愉快，心中非常难过。

en.t: Lady Tamakazura was very displeased to hear this, and her heart was deeply distressed.

units.source_text: 叹息说道：“没有像我女儿那种痛苦而悠闲安乐地度送一生的人，世间多得很呢。

en.t: She sighed and said, "There are many women in the world who live out their lives in ease and comfort without suffering as my daughter does.

units.source_text: 命里没有最高幸福的女人，是不应该产生入宫充当妃嫔的念头的。”

en.t: A woman who is not destined for the highest happiness should never think of entering the palace to become an imperial consort."
